title: fix(brain): REFLECT_BRAIN_SLUG names fireworks/deepseek/v4-flash, which no brains package registers
description:
# 🌙 dream: bhuild guards name a brain that no brains package registers

- **kind** = reseed
- **owner** = ehmpathy/rhachet-roles-bhuild (with ehmpathy/rhachet-brains-fireworksai)
- **caught** = 2026-09-26

## .the cue that fired

`rhx route.stone.set --stone 1.vision --as arrived` on `v2026_09_26.fix-blocklist-nudge`: both l1
peer lanes crashed with `BrainChoiceNotFoundError: brain not found: fireworks/deepseek/v4-flash`.

## .the gap, precisely

- `rhachet-roles-bhuild@0.21.36` hard-codes `fireworks/deepseek/v4-flash`
  (`getReflectBrainContext.js:11` `REFLECT_BRAIN_SLUG`, and the stamped `1.vision.guard`)
- `rhachet-brains-fireworksai@0.2.1` — the latest on npm — registers `fireworks/deepseek/flash/v4.1`,
  `…/flash`, `…/flash/latest`; no `v4-flash`
- ⇒ every route stamped from this bhuild version ships guards whose reviewers cannot run
- `rhx route.guard.upgrade` cannot re-sync the guard either: `unknown var: $slug`

## .the shape of the fix

1. in bhuild, reference the brain by a slug the brains package registers
   (`fireworks/deepseek/flash/v4.1`, or `…/flash/latest` if drift-tolerance is wanted)
2. or in fireworksai, register `fireworks/deepseek/v4-flash` as an alias
3. either way, add a bhuild test that resolves every brain slug in its guard templates against the
   pinned brains package — the same drift clamp, one hop downstream
4. separately: `route.guard.upgrade` fails on `$slug` — a template var it cannot fill

## .why it is not done in this round

safe: yes. clean: no — the fix lives in two other repos. a reseed, not a ride-along.
